title: Yosef and yesod: the toldos of the middos (Shaar HaYichud ch. 36)

lectures.id: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

overview: Chapter 36 explains the parzuf of Yosef, which is the middah of yesod of Zeir Anpin. The verse "These are the children of Yaakov, Yosef" is read as the source of the middos: the natural love and fear of Hashem become thought, speech and action through Yosef, the upper tzaddik, and through the small vav that gathers the light and shefa of the middos. Yesod is the power to bring a teaching to someone at his level, to package it so that it can be received, as a good teacher does. It is also the commitment that binds the mashpia to the mekabel, the covenant of peace that Pinchas received, and it unites the heavens and the earth and passes influence on to Malchus. Logic only reaches hod: it can make a person admit a truth, but the real connection is felt in the heart, from yesod of Abba, and it remains after the light of bina has gone. That is why Yosef is called an orphan from his mother and not from his father. The chapter ends with the delight of Ein Sof, the cedar in Lebanon, reaching down through the wall of Malchus to our avodah.

blocks.text: Yosef embodies and carries out all Yaakov represented: a special connection. The verse tells Yosef's story from seventeen until he went to Egypt.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In *davening* we list the first *sefiros*, *gedula* being *chesed*, through *yesod*. The verse says *kol*, all, as in *ki kol bashamayim uvaaretz*: normally "everything," but here differently.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Kol* can mean *hitkalelus*, uniting: *yesod* unites the heavens and earth, here the *mashpia* and *mekabel*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Shefa* from *yesod* is the spiritual *tzaddik*, the life of all the worlds.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: All the *middos* and the G-dly light of *chachma*, *bina* and *daas* are gathered into one form, which passes through *yesod* into the worlds.

sections.title: Yesod is the ability to bring it down to the recipient
sections.summary: A person can understand something for himself and still be unable to give it over. Yesod is the power to bring the light out to the recipient in a form he can receive, and it is what unites the mashpia and the mekabel.

phrases.en: and so what's an analogy for this?

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: somebody that understands something for themself

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אבל אין לו כח להביא אור השכל לידי השפעה לחוץ למקבל
phrases.en: but they're not a good teacher, they can't explain it to somebody else

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: עצם השפע הזאת כמו שהוא בעצמו
phrases.en: that's just the essential, natural *shefa*, the way it is in the self

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: An analogy: someone who understands an idea for himself but can't bring its light out to a recipient.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Bringing it down to a child
blocks.text: Some people are very smart, but can't explain it to someone else. Bringing it down to a little child means meeting him at his level, with a *mashal*, a candy, a little story: packaging the message.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The Rebbe at the rallies
blocks.text: The Rebbe spoke to little children at the rallies, which took wisdom. Bringing things down to immature *chassidim* is this *middah* of *yesod*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Someone who understands it only for himself can't bring it down. That is still only the essential, natural *shefa*, as it is in the *mashpia* himself.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אבל מי שיוכל להביאו להשפעה בגלוי למקבלים,
phrases.en: but somebody that's able to bring it so that it's revealed and expressed to the recipients

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: like a good communicator also, that's the idea of *yesod*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Others bring it out so it is revealed to a student or a little child: *yesod*, a good communicator who weighs the recipient and packages the message to his level.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* does not change what is said. It is the ability to package it so that it can be received.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: why *yesod* is called *kol*, *d'achid*, that it is able to unite the *mashpia* and the *mekabel*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and this is the idea that it's going from the *mashpia* to the *mekabel*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* is *kol*, from *d'achid*: it unites the *mashpia* and *mekabel*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In general, *yesod* is the quality of a teacher, the connection of a Rebbe to his *chassid*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Teacher, not only learned
blocks.text: Being a *talmid chacham* or a *tzaddik* is not enough to lead people. A Jewish leader needs more depth and maturity: to find the same idea, bring it down to a very low, immature level, and still give over its essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The Mitteler Rebbe has a whole *ma'amar* on this in *Lehavin Inyan Chavlei Mashiach*: *yesod* flows from the *mashpia* to the *mekabel*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Yesod is tov: giving so that the other benefits
sections.summary: Yesod is called tzaddik and tov because it is the power to give to the other, in a form he can receive and benefit from, and to pass on real essence, not just true information.

phrases.en: like it says, the light is sown for the *tzaddik*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and it says, about this light, *ki tov*, that it was good

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: And this is the idea that *yesod* is called *tov*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שמטבע הטוב להטיב לזולתו דוקא
phrases.en: that a person has this goodly nature is specifically to benefit the other

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The light is sown for the *tzaddik*: planting it in the ground is going into *Malchus*, his power.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Tov* means that the light is good: beneficial to someone. *Chesed* is my desire to do a kindness; *tov* means I am actually helping someone.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: G-d wanted the light to be revealed so we can receive it: this *yesod* is called *tov*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* is *tov*: it brings the light to another in a way that benefits him, so he gets the truth on his own level.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Being objectively true is not enough: Rambam writes *Moreh Nevuchim* for the one in a thousand, or ten thousand, who gets it on that level.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That does not reach the average person. For him you tell little stories and simple insights, and write a different kind of book.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Tov* is a goodly nature, and it is specifically for the benefit of the other.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* is bringing it to the other, not just having it. "I'm teaching it, but they're not getting it" is not teaching.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So the focus is on the recipient: that it really benefits him, not just that you handed it over.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כך בחינת יסוד נקרא צדיק וטוב,
phrases.en: this is the idea that *yesod* is called a *tzaddik* and *tov*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב אמרו צדיק כי טוב,
phrases.en: like it says, "say the *tzaddik* that he is good"

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and it says that a *tzaddik* is one that loves doing *tzedakah*, doing kindnesses and helping people

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the idea of *tzedakah* is to give life to people, physically or spiritually, by teaching them and uplifting them and inspiring them

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב טוב יהו״ה לכל כו'
phrases.en: like it says, the goodness of *Hashem* is to all

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* is called *tzaddik* and *tov*: a *tzaddik* does good to help others.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The verse says that a *tzaddik* loves *tzedakah*: he does kindnesses and helps people. So *yesod* is connected to *tzaddik* and to *tov*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Tzedakah* is giving life to people, physically or spiritually, by teaching and inspiring them; "the goodness of Hashem is to all."

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A *tzaddik* is not really about teaching, though teaching is a metaphor: he gives over real essence, real *chinuch*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Giving over *Torah* and *mitzvos* gives *emunah*, holiness and inspiration, the real essence of education (the Mitteler Rebbe's *chavlei Mashiach*). As in reproduction, you make one like yourself.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Spiritual reproduction, *yesod*, passes your true values and essence to another, so he follows your footsteps.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Everyone's nature and way of serving Hashem differ, but one essential thing about being G-dly is the same for everybody.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: To give over to someone lower, with a *mashal*, you must grasp the abstract essence more deeply, and then bring it down.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: To teach *Torah* and give over *emunah*, *ahava* and *yirah*, one must appreciate the *yechida*, the G-dly spark that connects a person to G-d. It is revealed on each one's level: *emes* is still *emes* for where he is.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That is what being turned on means: the *yechida* is plugged in for one's level.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In *Kuntres HaHispaalus*, the *nefesh elokis* is revealed on each level; what matters is being turned on and doing what is true for one's level.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Giving over is more than information, a particular *mitzvah*, or *ahava* and *yirah* a certain way: he should be turned on and try to grow.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Proud to call him a chassid
blocks.text: The Rebbe said he is proud to call anyone who commits to improve, even a little each week, his *chassid*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The Rebbe met each person where he was
blocks.text: The Rebbe related to each person differently. With some he pushed *chas v'tes*, with others *tefillin*, and with some he demanded neither, finding what each could be turned on by.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That is the real essence a *tzaddik* gives over, the essence of *Torah*: back to *taalumos chachma*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Seeing the inner core of *Torah*, one brings it in simple *meshalim*, *minhagim*, stories and *hanhagos* that connect a person to his *Yiddishkeit*, on each one's level.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The verse says the goodness of Hashem is to everyone: each person has a G-dly spark, expressed in his own way.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: He does not go into it much here, but *yesod* is related to *hashgacha pratis* in the *nimshal*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Hashgacha pratis* means G-d guides each person according to what he needs, physically and spiritually, giving each a unique mission and nature that compels him to live by it. There are different aspects to this.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Yosef: seventeen, the connection of teacher and student, and the covenant of peace
sections.summary: Tov is 17, the number of Yosef and of the letters of the words for the heavens and the earth. Yesod is the commitment that binds the mashpia to the mekabel, the covenant (brit) of peace that Pinchas received.

phrases.en: *tov* is the *gematria* of 17

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that, like we said, because *yesod* is uniting the heavens and the earth

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Tov* is 17 in *gematria*: Yosef's age when he was sold down to Egypt.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Yosef at seventeen went out to see his brothers: the idea of *yesod*, of the *tzaddik*, and of *tov*, which is 17.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Ahuh* has the value 17, the acronym of *et hashamayim v'et ha'aretz*: *yesod* unites the heavens and earth, the *mashpia* and *mekabel*, spiritual and physical.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: this is the connection between the teacher and the student, or the *mashpia* and *mekabel*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: as is known and as is explained elsewhere

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and *yesod* is also called peace

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and it's called a *brit*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: like it says by *Pinchas*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: הנני נותן לו את בריתי שלום

blocks.text: This is the connection between teacher and student, *mashpia* and *mekabel*, whatever the relationship.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: As *Tanya* explains, a father loves and knows his child, so he weighs what the child needs and teaches accordingly: that is this connection.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The connection, *yesod*, is a commitment to do whatever it takes to teach or educate somebody.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: An educator must be committed, whether it takes kindness or strictness, while always tuned in to the person's nature and needs.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The Frierdiker Rebbe, also Yosef, wrote in *Kuntres Klalei HaChinuch v'HaHadracha*: understand the person's nature and circumstances, balance kindness and strictness, and commit.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That is the *middah* of Yosef, as is known and explained elsewhere.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* is also *shalom*: uniting separate things, physical and spiritual, opposites.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A *brit* is a covenant to stay connected when the reason and the feelings of love are gone: "We're committed; I'll do it whether I like it or not."

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That commitment does whatever it takes to bring the feelings back, love and fear included, as in a relationship. That differs from *kabbalas ol*, a commitment only to action in *Malchus*: "I'll do it whether I like it or not."

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* is a commitment to a loving friendship: quality time, talking, whatever nurtures the relationship.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Brit milah* connects here: *yesod* is reproduction and the reproductive organ, *brit* the connection.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *brit* is our commitment to G-d, to be holy in how we relate to people, and to a life of giving to others, not only oneself: many aspects, connected to *yesod*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Here it is a *brit* of peace, as with Pinchas, who went with self-sacrifice against Kozbi and Zimri: "My covenant of peace."

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Pinchas became a *kohen*, having had only the blessing; because of that his *neshama* became *Eliyahu*, connected to *brit milah*: *Eliyahu HaNavi* goes to every one.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Yosef and Noach: the inside and outside of yesod
sections.summary: Yesod has an inside, Yosef, and an outside, Noach. Yosef thinks of others; Noach is focused on his own holiness. Yesod is the small vav that gathers the middos of Yaakov into one form that can be given over.

phrases.en: like it's explained elsewhere

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: בהפרש שבין פנימיות יסוד זעיר אנפין כיוסף, לחיצוניות
phrases.en: and this is related to the difference between that in *yesod* there's the *penimiyus* and the *chitzonius*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: יסוד שהוא בחינת נח, צדיק תמים, כמו שכתוב בזהר)

blocks.text: The difference: the inside of *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*, Yosef, and the outside, Noach the *tzaddik tamim*, as the *Zohar* says.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Like Yaakov and Yisrael, the inside of *yesod* is Yosef.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: If I understand, I didn't find a clear explanation, but from what I understood, Yosef is a person who really desires to help others and thinks only about helping them. That is Yosef in his whole conduct.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Yosef in prison
blocks.text: Yosef did not think of himself but of others: what they needed, how to help the Jewish people coming to Egypt, and, in prison, how the butler and baker felt.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Noach was a *tzaddik* focused on his own holiness. He built the ark and taught people from a personal obligation to be holy, not caring about them, so he was not successful in getting anyone to do *teshuvah*.

blocks.text: Yosef and Noach both sustained the world and saved it physically. Moshe is connected as the middle line: he is *daas*, which is *yesod*. He was born *tov*, with a *brit*, and so had this connection to *yesod* too.

blocks.question: How can the *middos* of Yaakov, the natural love and fear of Hashem, give birth to actual thought, speech and action?
blocks.text: Through Yosef specifically. The job of a *Rebbe* is to reveal the natural love, fear and *emunah* a Jew has, so that it comes to action. Moshe, in *Ve'atah Tetzaveh*, connects us to our *emunah*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* is the 17; this light is the 18th, the life that gives life to all, through this *midda*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is also *hashgacha pratis*: G-d relates to each person individually, and seeing that gives life to everything and inspires us.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: First a *tzaddik* is like a date palm, which is grown mainly for its fruit, the dates.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *tzaddik* rises to *taam v'daas*, understanding and reason, and then higher, like a cedar grown for itself, with intrinsic value, not only as a means to an end.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Lebanon* is *lamed-bet nun*: the thirty-two paths of *chachma* and the *nun* gates of *bina*, up to their source in *Keser*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The root of *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin* is in the *yesod* of *Arich Anpin* and *Atik Yomin*, which is above *sechel*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Zeir Anpin*'s *yesod* seems very low in the *hishtalshelus*: it only takes the *middos* down to *Malchus*. But that ability, like giving *meshalim*, requires a depth above ordinary understanding.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Bringing ideas down reaches above reason, into *Arich Anpin* and *Atik Yomin*. The real depth of *Torah* is the person's intrinsic value: its whole purpose is to help him, the *Thirteen Attributes of Mercy*, forgiving even one who sins.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Deeper still, in *Atik Yomin*, is the essential oneness with *Hashem*, higher than *teshuvah*: even one who sins is connected. *Torah* and *mitzvos* reveal that connection.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Appreciating that intrinsic value and essential connection, higher than *sechel*, lets you bring out *Torah* and *mitzvos* aimed at *emes*: *ruach hakodesh*, as it says in *Hayom Yom*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: And therefore we see that the main pleasure a person has is when they complete something

phrases.en: and like it's known about when G-d finished creating the world and there was the first Shabbos, that the main pleasure of Shabbos happened only when He finished creating everything

blocks.text: The beginning is connected to the end: the highest, *Keser*, is what Hashem really wants. The purpose of *Torah*, *mitzvos* and creation is *Yisrael*, the Jewish people; that is the end.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Zeir Anpin* is called the body, and *yesod* is called the end of the body.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The main pleasure is in completion: a person building a house endures a long process and headache, and is most excited as he is about to move in.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: There is a whole *ma'amar* on this in *Behiyoso b'Chavlei Mashiach*, and the same with intimacy: the main pleasure is in the completion.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

sensitivity.publishable: There is a whole *ma'amar* on this in *Behiyoso b'Chavlei Mashiach*, and the same is true of other goals: the main pleasure is in the completion.

blocks.text: The main desire is what a person really wants; *sechel* and *middos* are intermediaries to bring it to action, so the pleasure is not in them.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The real ultimate desire is when it is brought out and realized, such as bringing *Moshiach*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: As is known from *vayechulu*: the main pleasure of the first Shabbos came only when Hashem finished creating.

blocks.text: The verse says Yosef was very handsome, beautiful in appearance and in form, and that his beauty was similar to Yaakov's.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is the *tiferes* of *Zeir Anpin*, uniting right and left, top and bottom, which Yosef expresses. Beauty is connecting opposites: *yesod* connects *Keser* down to *Malchus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Simply, Yaakov's beauty comes from *Adam HaRishon*; in *Kabbalah*, from *Arich Anpin* and *Adam Kadmon*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Yaakov's beauty, which unites everything, comes from the original *ratzon*, in *Arich Anpin* and *Adam Kadmon*: a higher desire that unites everything and puts it together.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The ultimate purpose of this uniting force is a *dira b'tachtonim*, specifically Yisrael, through our *avodah*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That uniting force threads everything together; seeing that big picture, one sees how it all fits.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *avos* look alike: Yosef looks like Yaakov, and they all look like Adam. People in general look similar too.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: They are the true physical and spiritual children, carrying over mainly the essential goal, purpose and mission, not the physical.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Abraham and Yitzchak seem very different externally, but only in how they go about it; the essential aim is one.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The Alter Rebbe, Mitteler Rebbe, Tzemach Tzedek, Maharash, Rashab, Frierdiker Rebbe and the Rebbe each teach *Chassidus* their own way, toward one essential thing.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A deeper connection, the idea of *yesod*, unites us beyond the external form; seeing it lets you have that connection between people.

sections.title: Eileh is thirty-six: the six middos of Zeir Anpin, and the new mochin a toldah needs
sections.summary: Eileh has the value of 36, six times six: the six middos of Zeir Anpin, each made of six, united in tikkun. A toldah needs new mochin from Abba and Ima through the gadlus of Keser Chabad, and a general hisbonenus runs from Malchus of Ein Sof down to yesod of Zeir Anpin.

blocks.text: Why does the verse say *eileh toldos*? *Eileh* has the numerical value of 36.

blocks.text: The six directions of *Zeir Anpin* are six *middos*, each made of six: *tikkun*, where each *sefirah* unites with the others.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Uniting with others is vital to *tikkun* and the middle line: it is not about one's own *yesh* but getting the job done, so one cooperates gladly.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Six times six is thirty-six, the value of *eileh*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: מוחין חדשים מאבא ואמא על ידי

phrases.en: requires that you go have maturity of *Keser Chabad* in *Zeir Anpin*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A *toldah* needs new *mochin* from *Abba* and *Ima*, through the *gadlus* of *Keser Chabad*. The *middos*, the *eileh*, come into *yesod*, but to have children or do anything new requires that maturity.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *middos* must connect all the way up to *Keser Chabad*, with that development, so bringing it lower requires the essence it comes from, above *Zeir Anpin*.

sections.title: The cedar and the wall: the delight of Ein Sof reaches down to our avodah
sections.summary: The chain of worlds runs from Ein Sof to Zeir Anpin, and the cedar in Lebanon stands for the essential delight of Ein Sof, which was the reason for creation. That delight comes down, through yesod and the little vav, to Malchus (the wall) and to our avodah.

phrases.en: similar to like we said before that *Zeir Anpin*, we talked about the *hisbonenus* of *Zeir Anpin*, and how that is called the end of the world of the *Ein Sof*

blocks.text: As said above, *Zeir Anpin* in general is the end of the world of the *Ein Sof*. You can also think about that specifically with *yesod*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In *Kuntres Inyana shel Chassidus* he explains *Modeh Ani* as the union of *yesod* and *malchus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: On *pshat*, *remez*, *drush* and *sod*, and then with a deeper level from *Chassidus*: the lower unity.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Pshat*, *remez*, *drush* and *sod* correspond to *Asiya*, *Yetzira*, *Beriya* and *Atzilus*; through *Chassidus*, *Zeir Anpin* is *Asiya*, *Atik* and *Arich Anpin* are *Yetzira*, *Adam Kadmon* is *Beriya*, *Ein Sof* is *Atzilus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So there is a *hisbonenus* of the idea of *yesod* on each of these levels.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Shlomo spoke about everything; he knew all the sciences, and he lectured from the cedar in *Lebanon*, the biggest thing, all the way down to the little hyssop on the wall. That is the simple *pshat*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The cedar in *Lebanon* is the essential *taanug* in the *Atzmus* of *Or Ein Sof*: the original reason for "I will be king," the purpose of creation.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the way that it connects down to *Malchus* which is called *kir*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The original desire before the *tzimtzum*, which causes the whole *seder hishtalshelus*, is for our *avodah*. It reaches down to the hyssop on the wall, the little *vav* of *yesod*, into *Malchus*, *kir*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* comes down to *Malchus*, not only to *Zeir Anpin*: the treasures, as in *Ba'si LeGani*, light "higher and higher without end, lower and lower without limit."

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The real essence of the *Ein Sof* is given to overcome the *yetzer hara* in small, petty things.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The real essence of *Chassidus* and of Hashem's *taanug* is revealed in those lowly things: giving a person the inspiration to overcome challenges.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Our real essence is revealed when we are challenged: a person finds his inner strength when he must reach deeper, specifically when he feels small and uninspired, yet does it anyway with self-sacrifice and *kabbalas ol*. That connection goes up to the essence: this is the *hisbonenus* of *yesod*.

phrases.en: is because the *yesod* of *Ima*, the connection

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the logic goes away when the *middos* are born

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: He is an orphan from his mother because the *yesod* of *Ima*, the connection to understanding, goes away when the *middos* are born.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: When a person is excited and inspired, the logic goes away. The logic was only the trigger for the *midda*, which then takes on a life of its own and connects to something deeper than reason, from *chachma*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: It doesn't extend down

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: logic can just get a person to have a sense of *hoda'ah*, like I admit that yes, I believe it's true

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that can come from *sechel*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Bina* extends its light only down to *hod* of *Zeir Anpin*, not to its *yesod*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Logic does not reach *yesod*: for action, real commitment and feeling, it helps reveal and trigger, but it comes from something deeper, from *emunah*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Logic only brings a person to *hoda'ah*: he admits it's true but doesn't feel it. That can come from *sechel*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: This is the essential connection that's in the heart

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: And in there is shining the *yesod* of *Abba*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: בחינת התקשרות בעצם אור המושכל קודם שבא להשגה,

blocks.text: In *Kuntres HaHispaalus* he explains *hispaalus* from the *nefesh hateva'it* (the natural soul), which is more disconnected, and *hispaalus* from the *nefesh ha'elokis* (the G-dly soul), which plugs a person's *emunah* into it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The essential connection is in the heart: "Because I'm a Jew, I have to do it; because it's *Shabbos*, it's *kosher*." That goes deeper than logic.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Yesod* of *Abba* shines there; *chachma* is *Abba*, more related to our *emunah*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Feeling the essence of an idea before grasping it is higher than logic.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: He knows it not for a reason but because he feels it: it is part of who he is.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: There are levels of *emunah*: seeing it, and having it be part of one's *etzem*, as in *Ve'atah Tetzaveh*. A *tzaddik*'s job is to reveal the *emunah* higher than *sechel*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Sechel* helps, but the real beauty is when it triggers a connection higher than itself, needed for *mesirus nefesh* and *kabbalas ol* once *sechel* can no longer do it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: My heart saw a lot of *chachma*: the mind's eye sees certain truths, felt in the physical heart.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*: "I'm a Jew in my heart," a feeling that connects them.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is *ki karov elecha hadavar me'od*, "it is very close to you": we have an innate connection and feeling, and our *avodah* is to reveal it. Plugged into *Malchus*, into action, you are good.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב ברעייא מהימנא בעין השכל,

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: then you could see everything

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is *bittul* drawn down into the lungs, the *hevel* of the *chazeh halev*: we reveal that connection until one needs to express it in speech and action.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In *Ra'aya Mehemna*: no thought can grasp G-d, but the mind's eye in the heart sees everything, and can sense G-d's essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: לפי שיסוד אבא ארוך משל אימא,
phrases.en: and this is the idea that the *yesod* of *Abba* is long

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ונמשך עד בחינת יסוד זעיר אנפין גם לאחר שנסתלק אור הבינה
phrases.en: and it goes all the way down to *yesod*, and even after the light of *bina* leaves, that commitment and connection remains

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: על כן נקרא יתום מאמו ולא מאביו וכו'
phrases.en: that's why *Yosef* was called an orphan from his mother, and not from his father

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב ביאור זה במקום אחר באריכות
phrases.en: and this is explained elsewhere at length

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *yesod* of *Abba* is long, as the line says: the male organ is long, and the metaphor is that the connection from *emunah* reaches down to action, not just knowing. Tell someone "you really should do this" and he says "yes, I know, but..."; he won't do it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Knowledge reaches only to *hod*, admitting I should, not necessarily doing it. *Yesod* of *Abba* is longer than *bina*: it reaches *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin* after the light of *bina* leaves, and the commitment remains.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That is why Yosef is an orphan from his mother and not his father: the commitment remains from the father, while the mother's understanding goes when brought down from *yesod* to *Malchus*, explained elsewhere at length.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and this is also related to the idea

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that it says, "these are the children of the offspring of *Yaakov*"

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: בחינת טיפת יסוד אבא, הוא יוסף
phrases.en: that we're talking about this *tipah*, this drop that comes from *yesod* of *Abba*, which is again this expression for *emunah* and that inner *bittul*, is *Yosef*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: יסוד זעיר אנפין כו' ודי למבין):
phrases.en: that same thing that's the essence that's coming into *Yaakov* is what's going into *Yosef*, and that suffices to understand

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Also the idea of *Eileh toldos Yaakov*: the drop of *yesod* of *Abba*, the expression of *emunah* and inner *bittul*, is Yosef, the *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: What goes into *Yaakov* goes into *Yosef*, the *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*: *v'dai lemevin*, that suffices for one who understands.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/036 Shaar HaYichud ch 36 enhanced.mp3

reviewQuestions.question: What does the verse "These are the children of Yaakov, Yosef" teach about where the middos become action?
Why is yesod called *kol*, and what does it unite?
What is the difference between someone who understands an idea for himself and someone who can give it over to another?
Why is *tov* linked to the number 17 and to Yosef?
Why is Yosef called an orphan from his mother and not from his father?
What does the cedar in Lebanon stand for, and how does its delight reach down to our avodah?
